caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket with an oval shape, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and muted gold. The basket features a tightly woven body with a braided rim at the top edge and a matching base. A prominent, twisted rope handle is attached on each side, secured with loop knots, and there is an additional braided loop at the top center of the lid, which is integrated with the basket’s upper edge. The basket also includes an oval-shaped, braided loop on the front side, likely meant for securing the lid. The colors are primarily earthy tones, with some darker accents along the edges and handles, and a slightly reddish band running horizontally across the body. The plain, light beige background provides contrast, making the basket the central focus of the composition.
title: Cap Basket
